content.short: Zero Hash is a settlement utility offering an API-powered ecosystem of trading tools for brokers.
content.description: Zero Hash equips brokers with configurable tools to trade crypto on their own platforms via APIs that supply data and execute orders on demand. Brokers can white-label these capabilities, onboarding customers to trade and manage assets under their brand. Developers familiar with Python or JavaScript can integrate Zero Hash tools into their UI with only a few lines of code, delivering a seamless trading experience while keeping branding and onboarding under the broker's control.
